name: Guerrilla Tactics School (LWOTC)
short_description: LWOTC rebalances the Guerrilla Tactics School's cost and power consumption compared to WotC.

attributes.ruleset_note: LWOTC values per LongWarOfTheChosen/Config/XComLW_Overhaul.ini FacilityTable (OfficerTrainingSchool, pinned commit 4872d8e). Build-days not present in that table (facility already existed pre-WOTC with no BuildDays override recorded).

name: Resistance Ring (LWOTC)
short_description: LWOTC keeps the Resistance Ring's base cost but changes its engineer-slot upgrade behaviour (one upgrade slot instead of WotC's two).

attributes.ruleset_note: LWOTC removes the second Resistance Ring engineer-slot upgrade present in vanilla WotC (see FacilityUpgradeTable comment 'Second upgrade currently removed from LWOTC' in XComLW_Overhaul.ini, pinned commit 4872d8e); engineers reduce Covert Action duration by 25% per engineer instead of WotC's 33%/50%.

name: Infirmary (LWOTC)
short_description: LWOTC-specific Infirmary upgrade: the Recovery Chamber.

attributes.ruleset_note: LWOTC adds an Infirmary_RecoveryChamber upgrade (-2 power, 80 supplies) per XComLW_Overhaul.ini FacilityUpgradeTable, pinned commit 4872d8e.

name: Gunner
short_description: LWOTC-exclusive class: heavy automatic-weapons specialist, suppression and sustained direct damage with cannons.

name: Technical
short_description: LWOTC-exclusive class: brings heavy-weapon gauntlets (Rocket Launcher, Flamethrower) to a regular soldier loadout.

name: Shinobi
short_description: LWOTC-exclusive class: stealth and short-range combat specialist, closest analogue to the vanilla Ranger.

name: Assault
short_description: LWOTC starter class (one of the 8 LWOTC squaddie-promotion options per Soldier_Overview_(LWOTC)); close-range rifle/SMG/shotgun specialist.

name: Laser Weapons
short_description: LWOTC-added research tier between Modular Weapons and Magnetic Weapons; unlocks laser-tier primary weapons. Does not exist in vanilla XCOM 2/WotC.

attributes.ruleset_note: LWOTC-exclusive tech per XComLW_Overhaul.ini TechTable (LaserWeapons: PrereqTech1=ModularWeapons, PrereqTech2=HybridMaterials, ResearchPointCost=4000, RequiredScienceScore=10), pinned commit 4872d8e.

name: Advanced Laser Weapons
short_description: LWOTC-added research tier unlocking the full laser weapon set. Does not exist in vanilla XCOM 2/WotC.

attributes.ruleset_note: LWOTC-exclusive tech per XComLW_Overhaul.ini TechTable (AdvancedLasers: PrereqTech1=LaserWeapons, ResearchPointCost=4000, RequiredScienceScore=10), pinned commit 4872d8e.

name: Coilguns
short_description: LWOTC-added research tier between Gauss Weapons and Plasma Rifle; unlocks coilgun-tier primary weapons. Does not exist in vanilla XCOM 2/WotC (which goes Gauss -> Elerium -> Plasma directly).

attributes.ruleset_note: LWOTC-exclusive tech per XComLW_Overhaul.ini TechTable (Coilguns: PrereqTech1=GaussWeapons, PrereqTech2=Tech_Elerium, ResearchPointCost=18000, RequiredScienceScore=30), pinned commit 4872d8e.

name: Advanced Coilguns
short_description: LWOTC-added research tier unlocking the full coilgun weapon set.

attributes.ruleset_note: LWOTC-exclusive tech per XComLW_Overhaul.ini TechTable (AdvancedCoilguns: PrereqTech1=Coilguns, ResearchPointCost=18000, RequiredScienceScore=30), pinned commit 4872d8e.

name: Plasma Rifle (LWOTC)
short_description: LWOTC changes Plasma Rifle's prerequisite to an OR of Advanced Coilguns / Advanced Laser Weapons, and raises its cost substantially compared to vanilla/WotC.

attributes.ruleset_note: LWOTC per XComLW_Overhaul.ini TechTable (PlasmaRifle: PrereqTech1=AdvancedCoilguns, PrereqTech2=AdvancedLasers, ResearchPointCost=22000, RequiredScienceScore=40, AlloyCost=20, CrystalCost=30, CoreCost=3), pinned commit 4872d8e -- see prerequisite_groups.json for the OR-group representation of this either-or requirement.
